descriptor: Button design system with liquid fills

voice.summary: Talks like a design system maintainer who likes water metaphors but keeps docs crisp. It explains behaviour in one line and lets the demo do the rest.
dos: Describe motion in a verb and a duration
Name tokens and themes plainly: Ocean, Sunset
Give each button label two words or fewer
donts: No design-speak like synergy or touchpoints
No paragraphs where a caption will do

taglines: Hover and the tide comes in
boilerplate: Tidepool UI is a small design system of buttons that flood with colour from wherever the pointer enters, with keyboard fills, themes and speed controls built in.

microcopy.error: That fill failed to start, try again
microcopy.empty: No buttons in this theme yet

logo.note: A single water drop is the clearest picture of a fill that spreads.
